content.title: Spirit Air Awards Executive Bonuses Upon Second Bankruptcy
content.summary: The retention bonuses come after a previous bankruptcy restructuring that had promised ‘surgical’ precision and a swift debt fix failed within six months.  Chief Executive Officer David Davis, who took that job after the company exited bankruptcy in March, will earn a $2.9 million retention bonus.  Struggling companies often pay retention bonuses before filing bankruptcy because Chapter 11 rules restrict the payment of such awards during a restructuring.
